details.accumulation: wireVirtual sets original access/UPL flags,allocates page-info storage before acquisition. Early page-info size/append failure returns before this acquisition loop. Actual allocation success/failure not modeled.
details.abort: On abortExit gets saved block count,requests upl_abort then upl_deallocate for each saved nonnull UPL,truncates entries to zero-IOPL data shape and preserves error except two original remaps. upl_abort returns status from abort_range (or invalid-null),but caller ignores it;deallocate separately decrements refcount and may call iodone/destroy only at0. This is not universal page-free or successful abort/stopDMA proof.
details.prepare: prepare calls wireVirtual for virtual types and increments wireCount only on error0. For fresh failed import prepare it therefore does not create successful wire count. PreparedReadOnly is set on original completed Out wiring path,not a promise every failed prefix has no changed metadata. Existing already-prepared error case remains distinct;no blanket complete on failed prepare added.
details.release: Descriptor free for nonphysical types loops complete while wireCount remains,then releases memory-entry storage. Exact importTask releases failed descriptor before optional raw2 Out recreation,and sets NativeMemory preparedtrue only after successful prepare. This source order does not prove all lower acquisition failures return null output or all lower abort callbacks succeed.
